one_line: India's data policy, AI deals, and safety concerns dominate today's AI news.

themes.title: India releases DEPA handbook
themes.text: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology launched a handbook on the Data Empowerment and Protection Architecture, outlining a techno‑legal framework that lets institutions share data for AI training while retaining control through contractual permissions, clean rooms, and privacy safeguards.

stories.headline: MeitY releases DEPA handbook to enable trusted data sharing for AI training

themes.title: AI deals and fundraising surge
themes.text: Insurance software maker Guidewire announced a $1.7 billion cash acquisition of AI underwriting firm Hyperexponential, adding AI‑powered pricing tools to its portfolio. Speech‑recognition company Deepgram bought Daily, the maker of the open‑source Pipecat voice AI framework, for an undisclosed sum. OpenAI lowered its fundraising target to $20 billion while maintaining a $1.25 trillion valuation after securing $11 billion so far.

stories.headline: Guidewire to acquire Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash
Deepgram acquires Daily, keeping open‑source Pipecat framework intact
OpenAI cuts funding target to $20 billion, valuation stays at $1.25 trillion

themes.title: AI safety incidents and patches
themes.text: The Volta‑Autodoxer Windows infostealer sends evidence bundles to large language models to rank victims by asset value, employing a three‑model chain if a model refuses. Anthropic updated Claude Code and Opus 5.5 with a rule that blocks AI‑generated video game clones, preventing assistance with modding or reverse‑engineering. OpenAI patched a chain of vulnerabilities in ChatGPT’s HTML preview sandbox that allowed malicious code to exfiltrate user data, issuing a $5,000 bug bounty for the discovery.

stories.headline: Volta‑Autodoxer malware uses LLMs to rank victims by monetizable assets
Anthropic adds rule to block AI-generated video game clones
OpenAI patches HTML preview exploit that let attackers hijack ChatGPT accounts
